aside-w-sm.$description: Width of the SplitLayout aside at asideWidth sm (280px): a short filter or summary panel.

aside-w-md.$description: Width of the SplitLayout aside at asideWidth md (360px). Same value as the AppShell detail pane, so a side panel looks the same in both.

aside-w-lg.$description: Width of the SplitLayout aside at asideWidth lg (480px): a chat or an editor beside a list.

gap.$description: Default gap between the main content and the aside (24px); set at runtime via style from the `gap` prop (a space token key).

sticky-offset.$description: Distance (16px) between the top of the scrolling area and a sticky aside, and the room kept below it.
